Chance encounter, night to remember
Dec 2025 • Couples
Chanced upon this restaurant and had a most wonderful evening on their 12th night of opening! A small outfit and rather classy. Very pleasantly cosy. You have a choice of seating at tables or the counter to watch the chefs work their magic. We chose tables since it was date night. 

Loved the gastronomic experience my wife and I had, enjoying a fusion of Vietnamese and Western influences. Since we were first-time tourists to Ho Chi Minh, our waiter Thai was most helpful to explain to us what the dishes were about, including the inspirations for the various dishes, and recommending what would go well with the different things we were keen on. He also made it a point to come and check on us every now and then, interacting with us meaningfully regarding the food.

The flavours for each dish were delicately balanced, and while we were at times wondering how certain flavours would go together, it turned out to be extremely delectable. Kudos to the young and imaginative team for giving us a meal and an evening we will never forget.

What we had:
Dry aged grouper
Chuck steak
Tomato salad
Purple yam mash (but with the prawn butter on the side for my wife since I can't eat prawn)
Tres Leche
Flan
Keo Nho (cocktail)

Some highlights:
The fish was flavourful with crisp skin, and the sauce that went with it perfected it. We scraped up every bit of it just because it was so good! 
The chuck steak was extremely tender, surprisingly. None of the usual chewiness but packing all the flavour. The gravy was fantastic and reminiscent of Hong Kong char siew. The yam mash was the perfect pairing for it.
I'm usually not a fan of okra, but the okra chips in the tomato salad was exceptional - none of the annoying stickiness, while adding some light crunch to the salad.
The tres leche was also well balanced, unlike the overly sweet ones I've encountered so often.
For the flan, the fish sauce caramel raised eyebrows, but was a fresh take on salted caramel. Experimental and delightful. Nonetheless, I'm usually not great with flans, so I didn't want to finish the bottom half of this one. 
The cocktail was also delish and nicely rounded out the night. Do check out their very established bar on the 2nd floor! Many locals visited the bar when we were dining.

Definitely want to return, and just hope that by then it would not be impossible to get a table with how successful and popular I expect it would become!

Here's wishing Thomas and the team great success!
